workspace.text:
Hi Brad! I've checked Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's calendars. Here are the times when BOTH are free (30-min slots needed):

- Monday: 9:00-10:00 (any 30-min slot within)
- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday: 15:00-16:00
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30
- Friday: 11:00-12:00

Please check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars and let me know which of these times work for them too. My recommendation would be to try the longer windows first (Mon 9:00-10:00, Tue 13:00-14:00, Wed 15:00-16:00, Fri 11:00-12:00) since they give more flexibility.

Once we find a time that works for all four, I'll create the booking.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:

- Tuesday: 09:00-10:00 (1-hour window)
- Wednesday: 13:00-14:00 (1-hour window)

Could you check Priya and Marcus's calendars for these times? I'd suggest trying the 1-hour windows first for flexibility. Let me know which slot(s) work for all four!

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad, I checked your suggested times against Priya and Marcus's calendars, and unfortunately NONE of them work for both Priya and Marcus:

- Monday 11:00-12:00: Priya is busy (Travel 11:00-11:30, Contract review 11:30-12:00)
- Tuesday 09:00-10:00: Both Priya (Board prep, Partner lunch) and Marcus (Recruiting call, Litigation strategy) are busy
- Wednesday 13:00-14:00: Priya busy (Client call 13:00-13:30, Client dinner prep 13:30-14:00), Marcus busy (Partner lunch, Litigation strategy)
- Thursday 09:30-10:00: Priya busy, Marcus busy (Contract review)
- Thursday 14:30-15:30: Marcus busy (Dentist 14:30-15:00)
- Friday 15:00-16:00: Both busy

This is concerning - there's no overlap between our two lists. Could you double-check Elena and David's calendars for the times when Priya and Marcus are BOTH free? Specifically:

- Monday 9:00-10:00
- Tuesday 13:00-14:00 or 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday 15:00-16:00
- Thursday 10:00-10:30
- Friday 11:00-12:00

Maybe there's a slot that works that we both missed? If none of these work for Elena and David, we may have a scheduling conflict that makes the meeting infeasible.
